# EKPIX

> EKPIX (EKPIX Creative Web Studio) is a website design and development company based in India, building business websites, portfolio websites, eCommerce websites, and landing pages.

EKPIX designs and builds fast, modern, SEO-friendly websites for small businesses, startups, and personal brands. Every project is custom-designed rather than built from a recycled template.

## Services
- Website design
- Website development
- UI/UX design
- Responsive websites
- Portfolio websites
- Business websites
- Landing pages
- eCommerce websites
- Website maintenance
